prose: Andreessen Horowitz is investing $35 million in the Horowitz Andreessen Academy, an independent, unaccredited two-year alternative to college, the Wall Street Journal reports. Anthropic, Meta and other Bay Area tech companies are on board and will provide compute for the program.
highlights: a16z is spending $35M to back the two-year Horowitz Andreessen Academy.
The academy is an independent, unaccredited alternative to college.
Anthropic, Meta and other tech giants will provide compute.
